title: Playing with Marshall Royal in San Pedro
summary: In the late 1930s she played piano in a trio at a San Pedro club with Alton Red and saxophonist Marshall Royal.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Oh, that was in the -- that must have been in the '30s, the latter '30s, the latter part of the '30s. Before I started working with -- before I started recording or anything, naturally. But I can't --
We worked in San Pedro. We worked a little club in San Pedro. Alton Red was the leader and Marshall Royal was the saxophone player and I was the piano player. Three pieces.

But that was a marvelous, marvelous experience, working with Marshall, and in later years, you know, he went with Basie, and the same marvelous talent, he had it all the time. But it took a long time for him to really get the
recognition, but I'm glad he did get it. A marvelous musician.
